newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC wins 500 mln yen telecoms order in Russia.
newsitem.headline: NEC wins 500 mln yen telecoms order in Russia.

text.p: NEC Corp said on Monday that it had received an order from Russian telecommunications carrier Sviazinform to install switching and optical transmission systems in the city of Nizhiny Novgorod.
Under the contract, which is worth approximately 500 million yen, the systems will be shipped around the end of this year and start operating before the end of June 1997, NEC said in a statement.
The main contractor in the project is trading house Sumitomo Corp, the statement said.
NEC is one of the leading suppliers of telecommunications systems to Russia, the statement said.
